from src.util import slugify
import src.util as u

# docstring present and well-formed
d = slugify.__doc__
assert d, 'missing docstring'
print('--- docstring ---')
print(d)

# behaviour unchanged (matches README example + edge cases)
cases = {
    'Hello World': 'hello-world',
    'Hello, World!': 'hello-world',
    '  Spaced  Out  ': 'spaced-out',
    '--Already--Slugged--': 'already-slugged',
    '!!!': '',
    '': '',
    'MiXeD 123 Case': 'mixed-123-case',
}
for inp, exp in cases.items():
    got = slugify(inp)
    assert got == exp, (inp, got, exp)
    print(repr(inp), '->', repr(got))
print('OK: all behaviour cases pass')
"
